title: A 256-step certificate for Turán's pure power-sum constant
summary: We give an exact-input certificate for the upper bound C_42 <= 0.6888863712 in the pure power-sum problem. The construction refines the step profiles of Griego, Röhrig and Plata to 256 middle blocks, without changing their coefficient-cancellation mechanism. It improves the strongest public proposal located in our 22 October 2026 audit, 0.688970, by 0.0000836288. An unmodified public interval checker and a separately written Arb checker verify the strict finite inequalities.
